_about: The slot each skin draws around its badge, where the declared playinfo.type box sits off-centre inside it - the box held a format icon with the sample rate beside it, and the sample rate is never drawn here. Measured 2026-09-26 by flood-filling each skin's composed artwork from inside the box (17 skins); six more measured by eye on 2026-09-27 after every one of the 99 skins was rendered and reviewed: 113G5_Old Spectrum S+M (found by George), 19G5_Sansui 2V and the four TURN Vinyl skins. Nine more on 2026-09-27 after George photographed 102G5_Naim S+M and 108G5_Kenwood Rev S+M (whose first measurement stopped at a shading change, 67 px short): all 189 skins, animated included, rendered through the renderer and reviewed, then each window read from a ruled 2x zoom. Left alone on purpose: a slot that also holds the time (48G5_Vertical blue, 28/29G5_Technics, 168G5_Philips, 163G5_TEAC, 159G5_Technics Rec, 145G5_McIntosh MTI100, 148G5_Reloop RL7000, 144G5_Naim Turntable, 170G5_SonyK770) or the logo (06/08G5_McIntosh), and badges placed on an open background. A skin absent here keeps its declared box. [x0, y0, x1, y1], screen pixels.
